EXPERIENCE

PROJECT  

 
 A  STUDY ON WORKING CAPITAL MANAGEMENT WITH REFERENCE TO ULTRATECH 

CEMENTS LTD.   

• Analysing the financial position of Ultratech cements Ltd. (2018-2023)  

• By using ratios like Current, Quick, Total Assets and Fixed Assets Turnover Ratios and also 

represented by Graphs & Tables  

• Findings, Suggestions and Conclusion   



 

 

 AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE   

  

• Basic Understanding of Indian & US Securities Market &Trade Life Cycle 

• Good Knowledge on Mutual Funds like Open and Close ended funds, Interval funds, NAV 

Calculations and Life Cycle.   

• Good Knowledge on Private Equity Funds like Structure of PE, Management Fee, Waterfall 

Provisions  

• Conceptual Understanding on Hedge Funds like Investment Strategies, ABS and MBS, 

Crystallization date  

• Good Knowledge on Fixed Income Securities like Debentures and Bonds (Types of Bonds) 

• Basic Understanding of Corporate Actions such as Dividends, Bonus Issue, Rights Issue etc. 

• Conceptual Understanding of Financial Derivatives like Forwards, Futures, Options and Swaps  

• Basic Knowledge on AML/KYC and Transaction Monitoring 

• Conceptual Understanding of Equity Research like Fundamental & Technical Analysis etc.,  

• Financial Accounting like Journal entries, ledger posting, Trial balance and Final Accounts  

  

 SKILLS  

 

• MS OFFICE (Word, Excel and PowerPoint,Vba)    

• Tally ERP9 and Prime 

• Flexible and adoptable to working environment 

• Effective Communication Skills  

• Hard worker and Self Motivated  

• Ability to work under pressure   

• Active participation in team work  

• Time Management and Work Ethic  

• Problem Solving and Critical Thinking   

  

LANGUAGES KNOWN  

 

• English     - Read, Write and Speak   

• Telugu      - Read, Write and Speak   

• Hindi        – Read and Write 

 

HOBBIES  

 

• Playing chess 

• Listening Music
